purpose: Frozen state of the untouched 30-person external cohort immediately BEFORE its single one-shot evaluation. Every input to that evaluation is checksummed here so that no label, threshold, metric definition, subgroup definition or sample-inclusion decision can be altered after any result is seen.
evaluation_status: NOT_YET_RUN -- no cohort metric has been computed or inspected

final_sample_inclusion.exclusion_note: All 30 originally selected people completed the full technical pipeline. No person was dropped and no overflow-pool replacement was triggered.

frozen_evaluation_script.note: Checksummed before first execution; run exactly once.

frozen_deployment_thresholds.note: Calibrated once on the 5-person POC in Week 1; applied here unmodified.

frozen_metric_definitions.primary_aggregation: per-person metrics macro-averaged over the 30 independent people; candidate rows are never treated as independent samples
primary_metrics: transfer of the intended ~95% recall operating point
frozen_metric_definitions.model_selection_rule: No post-hoc model selection. M4 remains the predefined primary model and M0/M2 the mandatory baselines regardless of outcome.
frozen_metric_definitions.unknown_handling: Unknown candidates are never converted into negatives and never enter any supervised metric; they are counted and reported separately.
